name: SSR share-vs-volume mean-reversion long (stablecoin base large vs thin activity)
rationale: MECHANISM: a large stablecoin_mcap sitting against LOW total crypto volume (cg_total_volume) is the classic high-SSR 'coiled spring' — lots of dry powder, little activity to absorb it. When price is simultaneously washed out (bb_z low), that sidelined capital is the reservoir for the mean-reversion bounce. This variant reads the sidelined-vs-active gauge directly (stablecoin base big AND turnover thin) rather than timing a rollover. Other side = defensive holders who parked stables and stopped trading. DISCONFIRMER: if a long fired on the bb_z washout ALONE (no stablecoin/volume context) matches this net of fees, the SSR context is decorative and it is a generic oversold dip-buy. Split-sample kill: if the edge exists only pre-2024 and vanishes in 2025-2026 (mcap<->crypto corr ~0.4), it is a regime artifact.
catalyst: large stablecoin base against thin turnover into a price washout
